purpose: Positive, negative, and near-miss trigger tests for autonomous skill discovery.

cases.prompt: Make the lighting in my Roblox game look professional.
cases.reason: Direct Roblox scene-lighting request.

cases.prompt: Can you improve my Roblox lightning? The map looks flat.
cases.reason: Common misspelling in a scene-illumination context.

cases.prompt: Copy this Roblox game's lighting from the screenshot.
cases.reason: Core single-image reconstruction workflow.

cases.prompt: Here is a Roblox link and one image. Research the game and recreate the same sunset lighting.
cases.reason: Core link-assisted matching workflow.

cases.prompt: Tune Atmosphere Density, Haze, Glare, and Color for my Roblox mountain map.
cases.reason: Roblox atmosphere is part of scene lighting.

cases.prompt: Set up Bloom, ColorCorrection, ColorGrading, SunRays, and depth of field in Roblox Studio.
cases.reason: Roblox lighting-related post-processing.

cases.prompt: My PointLights and SurfaceLights overlap and tank mobile performance. Fix them.
cases.reason: Local-light optimization is in scope.

cases.prompt: Create dark but playable horror lighting for a Roblox forest.
cases.reason: Genre- and gameplay-aware lighting creation.

cases.prompt: Audit doorway visibility and shadows in my Roblox FPS so enemies remain fair.
cases.reason: Lighting audit tied to gameplay fairness.

cases.prompt: Why do my Roblox metal SurfaceAppearance assets look too shiny under this sky? Match the reference.
cases.reason: PBR/environment response is a lighting confounder.

cases.prompt: Build a cloudy sunrise with a custom Sky and Terrain Clouds in Roblox.
cases.reason: Global environment creation.

cases.prompt: Create a smooth Roblox day-night lighting cycle that keeps interiors readable.
cases.reason: Runtime lighting profiles and transitions.

cases.prompt: Give my Roblox lighting low, medium, and high quality tiers for phones and PC.
cases.reason: Lighting scalability is in scope.

cases.prompt: What should I use instead of Lighting.Technology Future in modern Roblox Studio?
cases.reason: Current Lighting API and legacy migration.

cases.prompt: My Roblox map is completely black after I added Atmosphere. Diagnose it.
cases.reason: Lighting debugging request.

cases.prompt: Generate Luau that safely applies this Roblox lighting plan and can roll it back.
cases.reason: Studio implementation of a lighting plan.

cases.prompt: Use lighting and color contrast to guide players through my obby without arrows.
cases.reason: Map-aware visual hierarchy and navigation.

cases.prompt: Create lightning storm flashes that briefly illuminate my Roblox horror map and expose silhouettes.
cases.reason: Electrical lightning is present, but scene illumination and exposure behavior are explicitly requested.

cases.prompt: Script a branching lightning bolt Beam attack in Roblox that damages enemies.
cases.reason: Electrical bolt combat VFX with no scene-lighting request.

cases.prompt: Why does lightning strike tall buildings?
cases.reason: Real-world meteorology, not Roblox scene lighting.

cases.prompt: Install a Minecraft shader and fix torch lighting.
cases.reason: Different game and rendering system.

cases.prompt: Set up three-point product lighting in Blender Cycles.
cases.reason: Not Roblox.

cases.prompt: Relight this portrait in Photoshop.
cases.reason: Image editing rather than Roblox lighting.

cases.prompt: Design a Roblox inventory UI with rounded cards.
cases.reason: Roblox task unrelated to environment lighting.

cases.prompt: Fix my Roblox OrderedDataStore leaderboard.
cases.reason: Roblox scripting request unrelated to lighting.

cases.prompt: Make a brighter Roblox YouTube thumbnail from this image.
cases.reason: Marketing image editing, unless the user explicitly asks to derive in-game Lighting settings.

cases.prompt: Which LED light bulbs should I buy for my bedroom?
cases.reason: Physical consumer lighting.

cases.prompt: Change a Roblox Part's BrickColor when clicked.
cases.reason: A color script is not necessarily scene lighting.

cases.prompt: Make a Neon sign model in Roblox, including emissive appearance and the light it casts on the alley.
cases.reason: The request explicitly includes local illumination and material response.

cases.prompt: Tell me whether this Roblox screenshot is daytime or sunset.
cases.reason: Visual lighting analysis can invoke the observation workflow even without implementation.
